synth.notes:
Player 5x5 ring (9) steps 6; move iff dest box all floor 5, or it holds the plate centre (rope 8 allowed).
Plate covered by player/ghost -> plate hidden, key tile (key bbox+1) slides 6 toward the rope line; vacated -> floor.
A5 off spawn toggles ghost mode (red HUD ring prepended / removed) and respawns at the first cell moved to; A5 on spawn no-op.
Ghost (colour 2) = player trail 2 moves behind, reset [level start, spawn]; moves only on successful moves.
Counter row 63 gains a 1 from the right on every even call (hidden parity). Unconfirmed: lag-2 trail vs re-running the recorded path.
